verdicts.reason: A puts the SOLSTICE wordmark below the headline, and the headline runs nearly edge to edge. Its three flavour pills are different sizes (Honey Rosemary is a large slab, the others are tiny) and out of the original order, so the centre stack looks broken. B has a strong headline and the brand at top-left, but the subcopy is set almost as big as the headline and competes with it. B's right column is jammed against the edge, the pills are reordered, and Blood Orange crowds the bottom edge.
